source_name: TheBanks.eu — Montenegro bank profiles and rankings
why_relevant: Free aggregator of ME bank total assets, market share and deposit-guarantee status derived from published statements; quick verification layer and actor map for the sector.

source_name: IMF — Montenegro Article IV / Country Reports and FSI data
why_relevant: IMF normalises CBCG supervisory data into Financial Soundness Indicators covering the whole ME banking sector (2014-2025 tables in CR 25/304); permanent, stable URLs — an effective archive of data CBCG may restructure.

source_name: MONSTAT — Statistical Office of Montenegro
why_relevant: National statistics office; macro and business-statistics releases used by IMF/ECB alongside CBCG data, with its own release archive and publication calendar.

source_name: RTCG — public broadcaster news archive (finance/economy)
why_relevant: National public broadcaster with a durable, dated article archive that reports official announcements verbatim; useful for timestamping disclosures whose primary PDFs vanished.

source_name: Montenegroberza AD (Montenegro Stock Exchange) — official site
why_relevant: Montenegro's only stock exchange and the statutory venue where listed banks (CKB/CKBP, Hipotekarna/HIBP, Lovcen banka/LUBA, Prva banka) trade. Root of all exchange-side issuer disclosure, trading data and listing decisions. NOTE: the domain 'montenegroberza.com' is NOT the exchange — it now resolves to an unrelated commercial frontier-markets content site; mnse.me is the real domain (email domain @mnse.me confirmed via company registries).

source_name: Montenegroberza — Vijesti / exchange & issuer announcements feed
why_relevant: Highest-value single page for this cell: carries Listing Committee decisions (Odbor za kotaciju), monthly bulletins, delistings, capital reductions, name changes, segment transfers and admission-to-trading decisions. This is where a bank's capital raise, symbol admission or suspension surfaces first. Observed real items dated Aug 2026 (XXIII sjednica Odbora za kotaciju; mjesečni bilten za jul 2026; EPCG capital reduction; LIMIT PRIME SECURITIES name change).

source_name: Montenegroberza — Simboli / listed-issuer symbol directory
why_relevant: Master list of all trading symbols (~416 observed) segmented by market tier (Prime, Prime Classic, Standard, Slobodno tržište, blok-poslovi, investment funds, debt symbols such as OB17-A / 1PBO1). Lets us build and maintain the authoritative universe of listed banks and bank-issued bonds for ME, and detect new admissions/segment moves.

source_name: Komisija za tržište kapitala Crne Gore (Capital Market Authority, KTK/CMA) — official site
why_relevant: The securities regulator that licenses issuers, approves prospectuses, keeps the issuer registry and enforces disclosure obligations under the Zakon o tržištu kapitala. Statutory disclosure channel distinct from CBCG prudential supervision — exactly the second channel this cell targets. Bilingual (/me/ and /en/ paths).

source_name: KTK — Registar emitenata hartija od vrijednosti (issuer registry, XLS)
why_relevant: Downloadable Excel registers of registered issuers, securities issues, investment firms and authorised credit institutions, fund managers and depositaries. Machine-readable master data for the ME listed-bank universe and the registration numbers used across KTK documents (e.g. Hipotekarna banka registered as issuer no. 3).

source_name: KTK — Novosti (regulator news, prospectus approvals and decisions)
why_relevant: Regulator news stream; date-keyed URLs (/me/novosti/YYYYMMDD). Carries registrations, enforcement/licensing items and — importantly — hosts approved prospectus PDFs under /images/novosti/YYYY/MM/, including bank offerings (e.g. Prva banka CG bond public-offer prospectus published Dec 2025).

source_name: CRPI — Centralni registar propisanih informacija (Officially Appointed Mechanism)
why_relevant: Montenegro's central storage mechanism for regulated information (the EU-Transparency-Directive style OAM). If it is populated, this is THE canonical single point where listed banks' periodic reports, material-event notices and major-holdings notifications are filed — higher value than any other source in this cell. Currently a bare 'CRPI Portal' shell with no visible public search; the operational filing side sits on scmnreporting.me.

source_name: SCMN Reporting portal (scmnreporting.me) — issuer e-filing platform
why_relevant: The regulator's reporting platform that issuers file into (hosts iam./portal./sp. subdomains per its TLS certificate). Understanding its public-vs-authenticated surface determines whether periodic bank reports can be harvested programmatically or must be taken from the exchange/issuer sites instead.

source_name: KTK — Godišnji izvještaj o stanju na tržištu kapitala
why_relevant: Annual regulator report on the state of the Montenegrin capital market: issuer counts, turnover, new issues, enforcement, and a structural view of who is listed. Best single retrospective baseline document for the cell and a pointer to issuers we may have missed.

source_name: Zakon o tržištu kapitala (Capital Market Law) — KTK regulation library
why_relevant: Defines WHAT a listed bank must disclose and WHEN (prospectus approval, periodic reporting, inside/material-event information, major-holdings thresholds, corporate-governance code reporting). Essential to know which artefacts should exist so absences become detectable signals rather than blind spots. Two versions observed: the older consolidated law and an EU-aligned text.

source_name: CKDD — Centralno klirinško depozitarno društvo AD Podgorica (CSD, ex-Centralna depozitarna agencija)
why_relevant: The central securities depository holding the dematerialised share register — the authoritative source for shareholder structure and ownership changes in listed banks, which is one of the three explicit targets of this cell. Publishes issuer and trading-symbol registers, debt-securities lists, and its own regulatory/business reports. Itself a listed issuer (CDAP), part-owned by CBCG and CKB.

source_name: KTK — CKDD participant profile page
why_relevant: Regulator-maintained profile confirming CKDD's licensed role and linking the depository into the official participant map; useful for validating entity identity and English-language naming for the CSD.

source_name: Hipotekarna banka AD Podgorica (HIBP) — investor relations / izvještaji
why_relevant: Listed bank issuer (KTK issuer register no. 3; MNSE symbol HIBP; trading in its shares enabled Oct 2025 by KTK decision). Publishes annual reports, auditor reports, balance sheets/income statements, Pillar-3 style public disclosure, shareholder-assembly notices and prospectuses (e.g. Prospekt HBO5, fifth bond issue, March 2026). Directly satisfies the periodic-report and shareholder-structure targets of this cell.

source_name: Prva banka Crne Gore AD Podgorica — prospectuses and issuer disclosures
why_relevant: Listed bank issuer with repeated public offerings — a single prospectus for the XIX issue of ordinary shares by public offer is hosted on its own site, and a bond public-offer prospectus was published via KTK in Dec 2025. Capital raises at this issuer are a leading indicator of ownership and solvency change.

source_name: CKB Banka AD Podgorica (CKBP) — management/periodic reports
why_relevant: Largest bank in Montenegro by assets (~EUR 2.2bn, ~28% share), OTP Group subsidiary, symbol CKBP on the MNSE Prime market. Publishes quarterly management reports on business performance (observed: Pojedinacni_Izvjestaj-menadzmenta-o-poslovanju_Q2-2025.pdf) — i.e. genuine interim periodic reporting, which is rare in this market.

source_name: Lovćen banka AD (LUBA) — issuer disclosures
why_relevant: Listed issuer (LUBA) whose block trades drove ~88% of Montenegroberza turnover in H1 2026 — i.e. an active ownership-change story visible through the exchange channel. Its own disclosures are the counterpart to the exchange's block-trade notices.

source_name: Investitor.me — Montenegrin capital-markets trade press
why_relevant: Specialist local outlet that systematically covers Montenegroberza turnover, block trades, issuer offerings and ownership shifts, with a dedicated 'montenegroberza' tag. Effectively an interpretive layer over the exchange feed and a fast way to detect events whose primary filing is hard to reach. Observed concrete, dated reporting (H1 2026 turnover EUR 30.33m, ~11x YoY, 87.9% from two transactions).

source_name: RTCG Ekonomija — public broadcaster market reporting
why_relevant: National public broadcaster with routine daily/periodic Montenegroberza index and turnover coverage plus corporate-event reporting (e.g. the CDA/CKDD renaming). Stable archive, useful for back-filling event dates.

source_name: MINA news agency — capital markets wire
why_relevant: National news agency that carries exchange rule changes and issuer news ('Nova pravila Montenegroberze'), often earlier and more completely than portals. Agency copy tends to reproduce official wording, making it a decent proxy when the exchange page is stale.

source_name: Investing.com — MNSE-listed equity pages (MOT/MNSE tickers)
why_relevant: One of very few international aggregators carrying Montenegroberza-listed bank tickers with English-language company profiles, price history and standardised balance-sheet/market-cap views. Useful as an English-language cross-check and for quick screening when the exchange site is unavailable.

source_name: SeeCapitalMarkets — SEE exchange aggregator (Montenegroberza pages)
why_relevant: Regional South-East-Europe capital-markets aggregator with a Montenegroberza section; useful as a cross-market pointer for comparing ME listed-bank disclosure practice with RS/HR/BA peers and for discovering additional data endpoints.

source_name: CompanyWall Montenegro — corporate registry mirror (Montenegroberza AD and issuers)
why_relevant: Commercial mirror of Montenegrin business-registry data (legal identity, address, activity code, financials) for the exchange itself and for listed issuers. Useful to resolve legal entity identity and detect name/status changes that precede or follow exchange announcements; it was the source that corrected the exchange's true domain (@mnse.me).

source_name: CBCG — Podaci o platnim uslugama i elektronskom novcu (payment services & e-money statistics)
why_relevant: Quarterly regulatory reporting aggregates on payment services and e-money submitted by PSPs under the CBCG reporting decision — card, POS, ATM and transfer volumes/values. The quantitative backbone against which individual actor announcements can be sanity-checked.

source_name: CBCG FinTech Hub (fintechhub.cbcg.me)
why_relevant: Regulator's dedicated fintech portal: strategy, fintech surveys and ecosystem mapping. Names non-bank payment players and emerging PSP/e-money aspirants that never appear in the licence register, and flags regulatory-sandbox style initiatives.
